GUIDANCE: Confirm every expected payment file was generated, sent and accepted; for a missing, late or rejected file record the interface, the run and the next action.
Confirm the clearing job cycle finished in its window without cancelled steps; for a late or cancelled step record the job and whether a restart is safe.

Review payment requests BASE rejected after SCHEDULED: every premium already collected through Stripe must show a successful refund. Record the reason, affected count and next action; refunds and retries stay with the existing SAP procedures.
Review ECT items still pending and their age; record the oldest item, the count and who follows up.
Confirm the outbound files reached the gateway and were delivered; record any file still queued or failed and the next action.
Confirm the reconciliation keys of the day reached the G/L for the BlackLine extract; record missing keys and the follow-up.
Review the open bank statement exceptions (blocks and errors) of the day; record the statement, the rule and the next action.
Review retrievals whose status does not match the bank statement; record the payment reference and the next action.
Review cheque payments without a cheque number; record the count and the follow-up with the print run.
Confirm the bank acknowledged every file and payment sent; record any acknowledgement still missing after its SLA.
Review returns and NOC lots not processed or ageing; record the lot, the count and the next action.
Review the open reconciliation variances of the day (bank, G/L, subledger); classify timing differences and record the next action for breaks.

Confirm every SAP job failure since the last review is assigned or resolved - above all a child that failed while the Control-M job finished; record the job, the root job and whether a restart from Control-M is safe.
